name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
title: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd - 544685 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Shadowfax grew FY26 revenue 69% to INR 4,200 crores+ with adjusted EBITDA near INR 159 crores, but management is raising capex and guiding 100–120 bps margin gains to FY28 with no supply discipline evidence.

utilisation.quote: Newer touch points mean relatively underutilized trucks, underutilized routes.

capex.quote: we have probably the highest capex spends ever and we are just doubling down on the strategy of everything under the roof

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR 180–190 crores, flat
triggers.quote: our guidance for FY27 will remain on an absolute basis very similar to FY26, which is in the range of about INR 180 to INR 190 crores

triggers.label: Margin +100–120 bps to FY28
triggers.quote: we are giving a guidance of 100 basis points to 120 basis points in terms of improving profitability till FY28

triggers.label: 3PL share ~28–29% vs 17–18% a year ago
triggers.quote: we have hit about close to 28%, 29% market share for the full quarter, which would have been about close to 17%, 18% one year back

triggers.label: Realisation dipped Q-on-Q on lower volumetric weight
triggers.quote: What we have seen quarter-on-quarter is that the average volume of the shipments has gone down.

guidance.quote: we continue to maintain the same trajectory guidance of 27% to 30% overall business growth
Hyperlocal, because the base is smaller will grow slightly faster at about 45% to 50% year -on-year
we are giving a guidance of 100 basis points to 120 basis points in terms of improving profitability till FY28
our guidance for FY27 will remain on an absolute basis very similar to FY26, which is in the range of about INR 180 to INR 190 crores
We'll be hitting about 17,000 odd pin codes by end of FY27.

red_flags.label: Lost shipments and QC debits ~6% of revenue
red_flags.quote: Q4 it's come down further to 6.1%. Our view is in the longer term, we actually we felt even 5% was a high number.

red_flags.label: No segment-level service EBITDA disclosure
red_flags.quote: We don't talk about service EBITDA. We don't look at service EBITDA.

evasions.quote: I think it's too early to say exactly this is the ROIC that will get when we actually scale it up.
We don't talk about service EBITDA. We don't look at service EBITDA.
We can't give you the exact split of that because I mean that's not a KPI we have been reporting.
